採用・広告の製品.quote: Tretau is setting a new industry standard by producing sustainable, solvent-free, high performance magnet wire for the automotive, industrial, aerospace, heavy duty, railway, power grid and robotics sectors. Our innovative solutions support the growing need for electrification across a wide range of industries, while driving sustainability and performance.
Less scrap with our coating process

DryCycle® is a future-proof magnet wire coating technology that outperforms traditional enameling processes. It offers superior ease of use, flexibility and improved cost-efficiency. DryCycle® works with both thermoset and thermoplastic polymers such as PEEK, PFA, PPS, PPSU, PAEK, PEKK, PA11, PA12 to insulate copper, aluminum, nickel-plated and silver wire.
Tretau produces magnet wire used in the windings of electric motors. We have developed the next generation of magnet wire that delivers the performance and efficiency needed for EVs.
Tretau presents a diverse array of magnet wire products, catering to the needs of high-power density and demanding applications such as aerospace, robotics and other industrial applications.

As pioneers in sustainable magnet wire manufacturing, we are taking a comprehensive approach to identifying, managing, and reducing the impact of our operations. We are committed to low-emissions production, resource efficiency and the use of recyclable materials. This allows us to significantly reduce the carbon footprint of our manufacturing and end products.

Tretau drives sustainable growth through scalable solutions, strategic partnerships and innovation. Technological development and human progress go hand in hand, and we have assembled a team of individuals who are passionate about their work and driven by a shared purpose.
Tretau’s concentric coating ensures uniform insulation thickness around the wire, providing optimal electrical insulation and reducing the risk of localized breakdowns.
Specially developed for applications requiring tailored insulation, eccentric coating provides variable thickness to meet specific design and performance needs.

Tretau’s magnet wire is designed to meet the specific demands of our customers. With fully customizable solutions, we produce magnet wire featuring a monolayer coating that offers best-in-class dielectric properties, exceptional aging performance, a bending radius of ≤ 1.0 mm (for rectangular wire), and a record-breaking adhesion stripping force of ≥ 2.0 N/mm (PEEK).

Tretau has developed DryCycle®, a patented technology that balances the need for sustainable manufacturing with the power, reliability, and performance required by electrification. The wire manufactured through this breakthrough process enables the electric machines of tomorrow: more powerful, compact, and eco-friendly.

DryCycle® redefines the efficiency, durability, precision and quality of magnet wire production. Our solvent-free, monolayer coating process offers three key benefits: it reduces operational complexity, minimizes environmental impact and enhances performance.

DryCycle® is compatible with both thermoset and thermoplastic polymers, allowing greater versatility in product development. With strategic partnerships throughout our supply chain, we are able to reduce lead times.

Our continuous sensor monitoring alongside a marking system enables us to guarantee precision and accuracy throughout the coating process, thus ensuring compliance with specifications in the final product. We produce high-performance magnet wire.
Quality is part of our process

Through a robust, ISO 9001:2015-certified Quality Management System, we ensure consistent compliance, continuous improvement, and adaptability to evolving market needs. By investing in skilled professionals and fostering a culture of learning, we empower our team to uphold excellence across every process.
We pride ourselves on being deeply specialized engineers within several connected industries, including quality control, wire coating, and MEMS monitoring.

We recognize that e-mobility applications are one of the most ambitious and transformative markets of today, which is why we're bringing our expertise to discover new and effective processes. At Tretau, we value specialization and expertise, and we're committed to making a positive impact on the environment.

In the world of heavy industry, an analytical approach is essential for survival. Machine learning and AI provide us with a huge dataset that can improve our systems, operators' lives, and product quality.

At Tretau, we know how to read data and interpret its value into measurable objectives. Our products have multiple sensors and actuators, and we collect all those measures to recreate a picture of our devices. By using data analysis, we can improve and adapt our technology to meet customer needs. We value innovation and data-driven decision-making.
